pages.title: Tindr
pages.description: Tindr is an original desktop operating system for x86-64 and AArch64, written in Rust from an empty directory. Calm, sharp, and still early.

pages.title: About
pages.description: How Tindr is built: a small Rust kernel, a UEFI loader, capabilities instead of root, and a design system drawn from the Norwegian landscape.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.description: Tindr is built in 23 milestones, from the foundation through a 1.0 desktop. M0 to M2 are done. M3 is underway.

pages.title: Read
pages.description: What Tindr is, the principles it is built on, the ten promises, and how it is tested on both architectures.

pages.title: Download
pages.description: Download Tindr for x86-64 and AArch64. Images today are placeholders. Real bootable images will follow.
